# shopify_location (Resource)

A location. Optional attributes left unset are not managed. Import with the location `name`, or its numeric ID if names are ambiguous.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "shopify_location" "warehouse_hamburg" {
  name                   = "Warehouse Hamburg"
  fulfills_online_orders = true

  address = {
    address1     = "Musterstrasse 1"
    city         = "Hamburg"
    zip          = "20095"
    country_code = "DE"
  }

  active = true

  # Destroy deactivates by default; "delete" also needs allow_data_deletion = true.
  deletion_policy = "deactivate"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address` (Attributes) Address. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--address))
- `name` (String) Location name, unique per shop.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the location is active. Deactivating fails while it holds inventory.
- `allow_data_deletion` (Boolean) Allow destroying or replacing this location (only checked when deletion_policy = "delete"), which deletes the data stored in it. Defaults to `false`. Must already be `true` in state when the delete runs, so set it in a separate apply first.
- `deletion_policy` (String) What destroy does: `deactivate` (default) keeps the location inactive in Shopify, `delete` removes it and needs `allow_data_deletion = true`.
- `fulfills_online_orders` (Boolean) Whether online orders can be fulfilled from here.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Location GID.
- `legacy_resource_id` (String) Numeric location ID.

<a id="nestedatt--address"></a>
### Nested Schema for `address`

Required:

- `country_code` (String) Two-letter country code, e.g. `DE`.

Optional:

- `address1` (String) Street address.
- `address2` (String) Additional address line.
- `city` (String) City.
- `phone` (String) Phone number.
- `province_code` (String) Province or state code, e.g. `CA`.
- `zip` (String) Postal code.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <name>, or the numeric location ID if the name is ambiguous
terraform import shopify_location.warehouse_hamburg "Warehouse Hamburg"
```
